why: Hector Pasten's arXiv preprint 'Improved bounds for Szpiro's conjecture' (submitted Sept 2026) unconditionally improves the known bound log|Δ| ≪ N log N (2013) to log|Δ| ≪ N log log N, previously only known under GRH, and proves log|Δ| ≪ N for semistable curves — an improvement to the problem's own quantity. A separate Zenodo item claiming a full 'spectral proof' via a 'CronNet-Holo framework' looks like a non-credible/fringe preprint and was not relied on.
queries: Szpiro conjecture elliptic curve discriminant conductor bound improved
